name: Tangerine
siboNotes: Tangerines are well-tolerated and provide natural digestive enzymes. Their lower fiber content compared to other fruits makes them gentle on sensitive digestive systems.
preparationTips: Choose ripe, soft tangerines for easier digestion
Remove white pith if you have severe sensitivities
Eat between meals rather than with large meals to optimize digestion
Fresh is preferable to canned in syrup which may contain high FODMAP sweeteners
